The objective of this system is to develop a centralized Policy Circular Management System for university-wide usage.
This document provides a functional requirement overview for developing the new
This document details the project scopes, integration scopes, system architecture, process flow and related
appendixes related to the system requirements.
The scope of the Policy and Circular System includes:
related in the management of organizational structure module
Officers consisting of the Rector, Deputy Rector, Dean, Deputy Deans, Chief Librarian, Head of Office for all KCDIOM
Staff with access rights to specific module and able to use the system.

To provide a centralized platform for managing policy and circular documents so that all organizational policies and circulars are stored in a single repository, making them easier to manage, access, and maintain.
To improve operational efficiency and reduce manual processes by digitizing policy and circular management activities, minimizing paperwork, and reducing document duplication.
To improve accessibility of policy and circular information by enabling authorized users to search, view, and retrieve documents quickly and efficiently.
To facilitate the creation, updating, and publication of policy circulars by providing a structured process for managing document information and related files throughout their lifecycle.

Business architecture provides a high-level overview of how an organization's components, processes, and functions integrate to achieve its strategic objectives. It plays a crucial role in defining the business context, ensuring that the functional requirements align with the organization's goals and operational needs. This alignment helps maintain a coherent connection between the business objectives and the operational framework.
